decisions.reason: Correcting which domain or website is associated with each Wix account does not change the requirement that locations use separate Wix websites and accounts.
The source resolves domain-to-account mapping but does not change the location selector, its options, or the rule that each selection routes to the corresponding location website.
Switching websites or reconnecting domains to the correct accounts does not alter the reusable template strategy or future-location expansion requirements.
The mapping correction does not change the requirement for dedicated, consistently branded location experiences; it only addresses which website or domain is connected to which account.
The source does not change the master site's national role or booking responsibilities, even though the surrounding discussion mentions the main domain.
Correcting domain and Wix-account associations does not explicitly or necessarily change the requirement for separate location payment setups and payouts.
Domain and account mapping has no effect on the selected visual design references, layout characteristics, or design direction.
The source does not change the Wix booking platform, booking host, or Seattle booking activation rules; it only corrects website or domain account mapping.
Connecting domains to the correct Wix accounts does not change the existing requirement that operational data and access remain isolated by location.
The mapping resolution does not add, remove, or alter any master-homepage section or offering-visibility requirement.
Domain-to-account correction does not affect the mobile-friendly responsive-design requirement.
Switching websites or connecting domains to the correct accounts does not change the SMASH ROOM name, colors, logo usage, or cross-location branding requirements.
